reply_text:
I found one new 2024 candidate, and it only comes from a news report. Several known 2024 statements came up, but I couldn't open pages carrying their words.

**Candidate (seen only in news coverage).** An OfficeChai article from 28 November 2024 quotes LeCun on a podcast. It links a YouTube video but doesn't name the show, and I couldn't confirm when it was recorded. He says human-level AI is "quite possibly within a decade", "not going to happen next year" or "in two years", and that "5 to 10 years would be if everything goes great". This is probably the same claim as `2024-10-lecun-human-level-within-the-decade-if-lucky.toml`, but I can't confirm it's the same occasion.

**No date given.** In a TIME interview conducted 26 January 2024, LeCun said human-level AI "is not just around the corner". That page also had an unrelated sponsored block in the middle, which I ignored.

**Seen but not quotable:**
- **15 April 2024 post on X** ("it won't happen next year"): I only saw it in search results. The page wouldn't open, so I haven't quoted it. It matches `2024-04-09-lecun-not-surpass-human-intelligence-next-year.toml`.
- **His 16 October 2024 post on X** ("several years if not a decade"): this also appeared only in search results. It matches the recorded 2024-10-16 file.
- **Johns Hopkins Bloomberg Center panel, December 2024:** The Decoder only paraphrases him (AGI is "several years" away), with no direct quote, so it isn't listed.

**Other years.** A Davos interview I opened, which looked like 2024, turned out to be from 2025.

Two of my six page openings failed (X and Threads). One search was used up by a coding error that stopped after the first query, though every query ran only once.
